title: 32oz Vintage Glass Jar With Lid, Glass Storage Containers, Airtight Kitchen Storage Containers For Sugar, Coffee, Tea, Spice, Flour, Candy Cookie, Pasta, Cereal, Cute Decorative Jars
description:
About this item
High-Grade Glass: Adodeen storage jars are made of thickened lead-free glass, which is BPA-free for peace of mind, stable, and resistant to low and high temperatures.
Stackable Design: This stackable glass jar is designed for organizing your pantry or kitchen. Its unique recessed top design allows you to easily stack multiple jars on top of each other to save space and keep ingredients fresh.
Exquisite Cameo Craft: The sunflower embossing on the surface of the glass jar is exquisitely handcrafted and beautifully designed, making it an elegant choice for home decoration. Can be used as a housewarming gift or Christmas festive decorative jar for family and friends.
Versatility: Store all kinds of food tea, coffee, sugar, flour, spices and your favorite snacks like cookies, candies, nuts and more. Its durable and airtight design ensures that food stays fresh for a long time.
Easy to Clean: With its wide opening, you can easily reach the bottom of the jar by hand for thorough cleaning. Additionally, we do advise removing the lid before placing the glass jar in the dishwasher and handwashing it separately for optimal care.
